role: The ICrafting listener GuiContainerCreative registers so every client-side slot change in the creative screen is echoed back as a C10 creative-inventory-action packet (playerController.sendSlotPacket).
scope_reason: Plumbing of the creative screen, which is not ported. The one behavior with a native counterpart, the creative windowClick mode 3 handling, lives in container.c, not here.
notes: Creative-mode slot clicks (windowClick mode 3) are ported in csrc/engine/container.c:1741, but the screen that drives CreativeCrafting is not.
